CAPTION: The network can hold, but access can be lost through intermediaries or personal mistakes. Ownership is not passive; it asks for continuous care.

Even if you don't have your wealth in Bitcoin, you can measure your wealth today in Bitcoin, like your house or your equities or your bonds or whatever else you hold."
